audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly calls the magma pillar his 'W pillar'. The pillar is created by Volcanic Rupture (Q); Bellows Breath (W) is the fire-breath cone that applies Brittle.
audit.why: Q: 800 range, 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s, 'sends out a fissure dealing damage and slowing... after a small delay, a magma pillar forms at the end location'. W: 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, 'Ornn advances, breathing fire. Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle.' E Searing Charge (450 range, 14s) knocks up only on terrain collision — the pillar is what he rams you into.
audit.corrected: Pillar = Q, Brittle = W (and R), knockup = E into terrain or that pillar. Every reference re-pointed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Ornn / Skill / Morde x5. The packet chart over 2637 games reads Skill / Morde / Morde / Skill / Morde / Morde / Ornn.
audit.why: The page's own prose already agrees with the packet: whys[0] says level 1 is 'just farming', whys[1] says your Q+W spike lands first, whys[3] says 'It stays even here', whys[6] says he self-forges into a full tank and reclaims late fights.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 3 and 6 flipped in BOTH layers as one atomic group -> Skill, Mordekaiser, Skill, Ornn.

audit.whatIsWrong: 2+ items was written as a Mordekaiser row; Living Forge is the biggest spike in the matchup and it belongs to Ornn.
audit.why: Living Forge grants bonus armour and MR from all sources and lets him forge items anywhere, so he banks tank stats without lane time.
audit.corrected: Your spikes stay level 2-3, level 6 (Realm of Death, 140s at rank 1, 650 range) and first item; the late rows go to him.

audit.why: Volcanic Rupture 9s, Searing Charge 14s, Bellows Breath 12s are the three timers that decide when you can step in.

edits.before: Q start, but it's slow and telegraphed — Ornn dodges it on reaction at full HP. Last-hit, aim isolated Qs only when he commits to a CS.
edits.after: Neither of you has an all-in at 1 — Volcanic Rupture is 9s and you have no aura yet, so last-hit and Q only on his step-up to a CS.

edits.before: Q ranks make isolated hits massive. Ornn must hug minions all lane; punish every step away from the wave with the full drag combo.
edits.after: It stays even — Darkness Rise leads extended trades, but Searing Charge into terrain or his Volcanic Rupture pillar cancels a commit.

edits.before: Riftmaker omnivamp turns the Realm 1v1 unloseable into most matchups. Ornn's only outs are dodging Q forever or never being alone — neither survives a whole game.
edits.after: Living Forge builds him a full tank without lane time, and stacked armour and MR blank your aura while his knockups peel you off anything you cannot isolate.

edits.before: Wall-knockup setup. Don’t get pinned. Only engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: "Ornn has no heal and only short-range melee before 6, so your Level 2-3 spike is real — hit the Obliterate sweetspot (single-target bonus + a Darkness Rise stack), bank that damage into your Indestructible shield, and recast W to heal off whatever he chips back. The one thing to respect is his E, Searing Charge: if he rams you into terrain or his deployed W pillar it procs Brittle and knocks you up, so don't fight with your back to a wall or next to his pillar. Otherwise step up and trade — he can't out-sustain your banked shield."
edits.after: "Ornn has no heal and only short-range melee before 6, so your Level 2-3 spike is real — hit the Obliterate sweetspot (single-target bonus + a Darkness Rise stack), bank that damage into your Indestructible shield, and recast W to heal off whatever he chips back. The one thing to respect is his E, Searing Charge: if he rams you into terrain or his own Volcanic Rupture pillar it knocks you up, and Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, so never fight with your back to a wall or beside that pillar. Otherwise step up and trade."

edits.before: "This is Ornn's lane. He self-forges his items, so he becomes a full tank without giving up gold, and his stacked armor plus magic resist starve your aura and Q of damage. In a teamfight you can't isolate him cleanly — his W pillar, E knockup and R double-knockup peel you off any carry and break your grind before it pays. Don't chase the 1v1 hoping for a Realm of Death reset; play for an early lead and let your team answer the late-game tank, because point-for-point he out-scales your flat mid-game."

notes: Two real defects. (1) Slot error repeated across the page: the magma pillar comes from Volcanic Rupture (Q), not from Bellows Breath (W); W is the Brittle cone, and Searing Charge (E) is what rams you into terrain or that pillar for the knockup. (2) The level chart disagreed with a 2637-game packet in four rows while the page's own whys already described those rows correctly — proposed as one atomic paired group. Ornn Q also carries the derived 'grounding' flag purely from 'slams the ground'; not asserted anywhere. Not asserted (kits do not cover it): whether Brittle's knockup extension is reduced by tenacity, and whether Realm of Death removes an already-applied Brittle.
